description: Executive orders to advance Keystone XL and Dakota Access pipelines
notes: Confirmed signed January 24 2017 in the Oval Office.

description: Executive order to review and roll back Clean Power Plan
notes: EO 13783 (Promoting Energy Independence) signed March 28 2017. Date confirmed.

description: Executive order to expand offshore drilling
notes: Signed April 28 2017 (Friday). NPR headline says April 27 but that was the pre-announcement; signing was April 28.

description: EO 13808 imposes financial sanctions on Venezuela/PDVSA
notes: EO 13808 signed August 24 2017 but effective 12:01 AM EDT August 25 2017. Catalog uses August 25 which is the effective date and first market-relevant trading day (Friday). Acceptable for event study.

description: Trump decertifies Iran nuclear deal but does not withdraw
notes: Trump decertified JCPOA on October 13 2017. Date confirmed by multiple sources.

description: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act signed; opens ANWR to drilling
notes: Signed December 22 2017. Senate passed Dec 20; House re-voted Dec 20; Trump signed Dec 22. Date confirmed.

description: Trump waives Iran sanctions again signals last time
notes: Confirmed January 12 2018. Trump stated this is a last chance and he will not waive again.

description: Trump tweets Oil prices are artificially Very High blaming OPEC
notes: Confirmed April 20 2018 (Friday). Tweet posted that morning.

description: Trump withdraws from JCPOA reinstates Iran sanctions
notes: Confirmed May 8 2018 announcement from the Diplomatic Reception Room.

description: OPEC agrees to increase oil production at Vienna meeting
notes: Confirmed June 22 2018 (Friday). Agreement to nominally raise output by 1 million bpd.

description: Trump tweets at OPEC: REDUCE PRICING NOW
notes: Tweet posted July 4 2018 but that is Independence Day and US markets were closed. For event study purposes the market reaction date should be July 5 2018 (next trading day). Change catalog date to 2018-07-05.

description: Trump tweets OPEC monopoly must get prices down now
notes: Confirmed September 20 2018 (Thursday). Oil prices dropped on the tweet.

description: Iran oil sanctions take effect but 8 countries granted waivers
notes: Waivers were first reported November 2 2018 (Friday) but sanctions formally took effect November 5 2018 (Monday). Catalog uses Nov 5 which is the effective date and also a trading day. Either date is defensible; Nov 5 is fine for event study.

description: Trump tweets Thank you to Saudi Arabia for lower oil prices
notes: Confirmed November 21 2018 (Wednesday). Came day after Trump released statement standing by Saudi Arabia despite Khashoggi killing.

description: OPEC+ agrees to cut production by 1.2 million bpd
notes: Confirmed December 7 2018 (Friday). OPEC to cut 800k bpd plus Russia/allies 400k bpd.

description: Treasury designates PDVSA under EO 13850
notes: Confirmed January 28 2019 (Monday). OFAC designated PDVSA blocking $7B in assets.

description: Trump tweets Oil prices getting too high OPEC please relax
notes: Confirmed February 25 2019 (Monday). Oil dropped 3% on the tweet.

description: EOs 13867/13868 streamline pipeline permitting
notes: Confirmed April 10 2019 (Wednesday). Both EOs signed same day.

description: Trump ends Iran oil sanction waivers demands zero exports
notes: Confirmed April 22 2019 (Monday). Pompeo announced no waivers will be renewed.

description: Iran shoots down US drone; Trump orders then cancels retaliatory strike
notes: Drone shot down June 20 2019 (Thursday). Trump approved then cancelled strike that evening. He tweeted about it June 21. Catalog date of June 20 is correct for the market-moving shootdown event.

description: EO 13884 blocks all property of Venezuelan government
notes: EO 13884 signed August 5 2019 (Monday). Full economic embargo on Venezuelan government property. Date confirmed.

description: Markets open after Abqaiq-Khurais drone attack; oil surges ~15%
notes: Attack occurred September 14 2019 (Saturday). Markets opened Monday Sept 16 with WTI and Brent up ~14%. Catalog correctly uses Sept 16 (next trading day).

description: US kills Qasem Soleimani in Baghdad airstrike
notes: Strike at ~1 AM Baghdad time Jan 3 (10 PM UTC Jan 2). US markets were open Jan 3. Catalog date of Jan 3 is correct.

description: Iran retaliates with missile strikes on US bases; Trump signals de-escalation
notes: Missiles launched early morning Jan 8 Iraq time. Trump addressed the nation later Jan 8 saying Iran appears to be standing down. Date confirmed.

description: Saudi-Russia price war erupts; oil crashes 25%
notes: Saudi Arabia announced price discounts March 8 (Sunday). Markets crashed March 9 (Monday) with oil down ~25%. Catalog correctly uses March 9.

description: Trump declares COVID-19 national emergency; directs DOE to fill SPR
notes: National emergency declared March 13 2020 (Friday). Trump said will fill SPR to the top. Date confirmed.

description: Trump brokers Saudi-Russia OPEC+ deal to cut production
notes: Trump tweeted April 2 2020 (Thursday) about expected 10M bpd cut after speaking with Putin and MBS. Oil spiked 25% that day. The formal OPEC+ deal was finalized April 12 but the market-moving announcement was April 2. Date is correct for event study.

description: Inauguration Day: Drill Baby Drill executive orders and Paris withdrawal
notes: Date is correct. Trump signed Paris withdrawal EO and energy emergency EO 14156 on inauguration day January 20 2025.

description: Trump tells Davos he will demand Saudi Arabia and OPEC bring oil prices down
notes: Confirmed January 23 2025 (Thursday). Trump addressed Davos virtually and demanded OPEC lower prices.

description: OPEC+ JMMC meeting maintains existing production cuts despite Trump pressure
notes: 58th JMMC met via videoconference February 3 2025 (Monday). Reaffirmed gradual return of 2.2M bpd voluntary adjustments starting April 1 2025. Date confirmed.

description: NSPM-2 reimposes maximum pressure sanctions on Iran
notes: Date correct. NSPM-2 signed Feb 4 2025 restoring maximum pressure on Iran.

description: Trump sends letter to Ayatollah Khamenei seeking nuclear negotiations
notes: Letter was sent around March 5 but Trump confirmed it publicly via Fox Business interview aired March 7. Catalog uses March 7 which is the public disclosure date and market-relevant. Date is acceptable.

description: EO 14245 imposes 25% secondary tariffs on countries importing Venezuelan oil
notes: EO 14245 signed March 24 2025. Tariffs take effect April 2 2025. Signing date confirmed.

description: Liberation Day: Trump announces 10% baseline reciprocal tariffs on all countries
notes: Confirmed April 2 2025 (Wednesday). EO 14257 signed in Rose Garden ceremony. 10% baseline took effect April 5; higher rates April 9.

description: OPEC+ unexpectedly accelerates output restoration adding 411k bpd in May
notes: Confirmed April 3 2025 (Thursday). Eight OPEC+ members agreed to 411k bpd increase for May (three monthly increments at once).

description: Trump pauses reciprocal tariffs above 10% for 90 days except China
notes: Confirmed April 9 2025 (Wednesday). Announced via Truth Social. Markets surged (Dow +2900 pts). China tariffs raised to 125%.

description: OPEC+ announces second consecutive accelerated 411k bpd output hike for June
notes: Confirmed May 3 2025 (Saturday). Eight OPEC+ members agreed to 411k bpd increase for June. Next trading day is Monday May 5.

description: Trump Gulf tour; Saudi Arabia announces $600B investment commitment
notes: Confirmed May 13 2025 (Tuesday). $600B in investment deals announced during Trump's Saudi visit.

description: OPEC+ agrees to third consecutive 411k bpd accelerated output hike for July
notes: Confirmed May 31 2025 (Saturday). Eight OPEC+ members agreed to 411k bpd increase for July. Next trading day is Monday June 2.

description: Israel launches surprise strikes on Iran beginning the Twelve-Day War
notes: Confirmed early hours of June 13 2025 (Friday). IDF struck Iranian nuclear facilities and military bases with 200+ fighter jets. Markets were open.

description: US Operation Midnight Hammer strikes Iranian nuclear facilities
notes: Confirmed June 22 2025 (Sunday). US struck Fordow Natanz and Isfahan with B-2 bombers. June 22 was a Sunday so next trading day is June 23.

description: Twelve-Day War ceasefire announced by Trump
notes: Trump announced ceasefire evening of June 23 via Truth Social; ceasefire took effect June 24 2025 (Tuesday). Catalog uses June 24 which is when markets reacted. Correct.

description: OPEC+ accelerates output unwinding approving 548k bpd increase for August
notes: Confirmed July 5 2025 (Saturday). Eight OPEC+ members met virtually and approved 548k bpd increase for August (four monthly increments). Next trading day is Monday July 7.

description: OPEC+ agrees to 547k bpd output increase for September
notes: Confirmed August 3 2025 (Sunday). 547k bpd increase for September. Next trading day is Monday August 4.

description: OPEC+ slows pace of output increases to 137k bpd for October
notes: Confirmed September 7 2025 (Sunday). Significantly slower pace than prior months. Next trading day is Monday September 8.

description: Treasury sanctions 50+ entities in Iran oil network including Chinese teapot refineries
notes: Confirmed October 9 2025 (Thursday). State Department and Treasury jointly announced sweeping sanctions on ~40+ individuals entities and vessels in Iran energy trade.

description: OPEC+ pauses output hikes for Q1 2026 reversing unwinding trend
notes: Confirmed November 2 2025 (Sunday). Eight OPEC+ members agreed to pause increments in Jan-Feb-Mar 2026 due to seasonality. Next trading day is Monday November 3.

description: Interior Dept proposes massive 2026-2031 offshore leasing program
notes: Confirmed November 24 2025 (Monday). Draft proposed program published in Federal Register same day covering 34 lease sales across 1.27 billion acres.

description: OPEC+ reaffirms Q1 2026 output pause and extends group-wide cuts through end of 2026
notes: Confirmed November 30 2025 (Sunday). 40th OPEC and non-OPEC Ministerial Meeting reaffirmed Q1 2026 pause and kept group-wide cuts through end of 2026. Next trading day is Monday December 1.

description: Third round of US-Iran nuclear talks in Geneva ends without deal
notes: Confirmed February 26 2026 (Thursday). Third round of indirect talks in Geneva mediated by Oman. No deal reached but parties agreed to technical talks in Vienna.

description: Operation Epic Fury: US-Israel air campaign against Iran; Khamenei killed; Strait of Hormuz closed
notes: Confirmed February 28 2026 (Saturday). US and Israel launched Operation Epic Fury / Roaring Lion. Khamenei killed in Israeli air attack. Iran closed Strait of Hormuz. Next trading day is Monday March 2.

description: OPEC+ emergency meeting agrees to 206k bpd increase amid Strait of Hormuz closure
notes: Confirmed March 1 2026 (Sunday). OPEC+ agreed to 206k bpd increase for April. Analysts noted this was minimal given Hormuz disruption. Next trading day is Monday March 2.

description: Trump authorizes 172M barrel SPR emergency release; IEA coordinates 400M barrel global drawdown
notes: Confirmed March 11 2026 (Wednesday). DOE announced 172M barrel release coordinated with IEA 32-nation 400M barrel drawdown.

description: Treasury eases sanctions on Russian oil (GL-134): 30-day waiver suspending price cap
notes: Confirmed March 12 2026 (Thursday). GL-134 authorized delivery and sale of Russian-origin crude loaded on vessels as of March 12. Expired April 11.

description: Treasury lifts sanctions on 140M barrels of Iranian crude on vessels (30-day waiver)
notes: Confirmed March 20 2026 (Friday). 30-day waiver allowing sale of ~140M barrels of Iranian oil already on vessels. Expired April 19.

description: Trump primetime address threatens to bomb Iran back to the Stone Ages; oil above $105
notes: Confirmed April 1 2026 (Wednesday). Primetime address; Brent spiked above $105. Trump said US would bring them back to the stone ages.

description: Trump announces Pakistan-mediated ceasefire with Iran
notes: Confirmed April 7 2026 (Tuesday). Two-week ceasefire announced via Truth Social conditioned on Iran opening Strait of Hormuz. Pakistan mediated.

description: Trump indefinitely extends Iran ceasefire; maintains naval blockade
notes: Confirmed April 21 2026 (Tuesday). Ceasefire extended indefinitely pending unified Iranian proposal. Naval blockade maintained.

description: Treasury sanctions Chinese teapot refinery Hengli and ~40 Iranian oil shipping companies
notes: Confirmed April 24 2026 (Friday). OFAC sanctioned Hengli Petrochemical (Dalian) and ~40 shadow fleet vessels/firms.
